steps.name: Colors of Emotion (9)
steps.objective: Talk to [Minuet] in 「Adrica」, then find [Notos] in 「Nereis Gateway」.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Oh, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I somehow felt I should come see you, Minuet... Nothing's happened, has it? I mean, have you been well?
(Minuet looks slightly surprised at being asked whether she has been well, then returns to her usual expressionless face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet? Why are you surprised?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: That greeting felt different from before. For a moment, being asked if I'd been well felt so wonderful...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, I've been well. Adrica is peaceful too. It's all thanks to you.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: It's wonderful to be able to look at Laphia from Adrica. Have you been well too, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have. Oh, I visited a new region in the meantime.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Because of a witch, I imagine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Demon Realm has been trying to connect to our world for a long time. Iris said she'd sensed such attempts recently...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Among them was a force trying to connect to the Demon Realm from this side...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: A witch...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm gathering information with help from others. That's how I met a new witch in that new region.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Please tell me about your visit...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I may be able to help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, of course. It all started when...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Minuet what happened on Aie Island.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'm a little surprised to hear an incarnate god is there.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I'd like to meet him someday... Someone I didn't recognize, but who recognized me...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I wonder what the ancient god he served was like. Lady Gaia may know.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: You said the place full of gates powered by magic is called the Nereis Gateway?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. The Nereis Gateway.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: With so many people passing through and so much magic, there might be a clue about the hourglasses there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, now that we've mentioned it, I'll go look for the hourglasses right away. Nothing serious has happened yet, but it's better to check.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Take care... Thank you for telling me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Minuet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I should ask Notos.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: What does it feel like to be given the will to live...?

steps.name: Colors of Emotion (10)
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Notos] in 「Nereis Gateway」, then find [Hayden] on 「Aie Island」.
2. Defeat monsters on 「Aie Island」 to obtain a <Letter to a Younger Sibling>, then return to 「Nereis Gateway」 and report to [Notos].

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Welcome, %s. Edam and I were just talking about you, %s. And here you are!

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Hello, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. You're both here.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: You've arrived just as the Elias saying Yeonhee taught me goes. A tiger leaves its skin when it dies...

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Notos, I believe you've mixed it up with another saying. It was, 'When a magpie calls, a welcome guest arrives'...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: That's right. Yeonhee taught me so many that I must have confused them for a moment.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Anyway, I'm sorry I couldn't properly greet you then. It was my oversight.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: As the gateway's supervisor, I should have checked the gate properly. I put its users in danger.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That wasn't your fault, Notos.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: His Majesty and many others have said it's all right, but I was arrogant to believe I knew everything about the gates.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I will have to study them more closely. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I'll help as well.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: You already do your part just by being here, Edam.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. Didn't Yeonhee leave for western Freios?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: For some reason, she became separated from her companions on the way, got lost, and returned to the gateway.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I have a feeling we'll be seeing Yeonhee at the gateway quite often. Edam also handles assistance for lost visitors, so it should be fine.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: When she left, she promised to pay close attention to her surroundings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha. Nothing else unusual has happened, then?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: ...No, nothing serious at the moment. But is there something you need help with? Just say the word, and I'll assist.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I just wanted to hear a few things.
(Edam nods quietly, as though understanding.)

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Notos, why not tell %s about that?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: ...Shall I, Edam? %s, the thing is... I've lost some letters meant for my younger brother.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letters?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Our father always wrote letters when he wanted to express his feelings. He said that if something was hard to say aloud, we should convey our sincere thoughts in a letter.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: ...So whenever my brother and I argued, I would send a letter asking to make peace. But after Zephyros and I took different paths, every letter came back... Haha...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: They bear a mark visible only through our family's magic. Apparently, he dislikes that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Where did you lose the letters?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: ...I'm embarrassed to say, in my room. It was my mistake. I forgot that the wind blowing through here is sensitive to magic...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I was sorting the returned letters with the window open when a gust came in and blew them all outside.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: They must have entered a vortex of magic, so there seems little chance of finding them.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: ...I hurried to track where the wind went... It was the island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aie Island... I'll go and look.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Would that be all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have another reason to go back, so please don't feel bad. I'll look while I'm there, though you shouldn't get your hopes too high...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Thank you anyway, %s. Oh, you can use the same gate to Aie Island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Wasn't the gate to Aie Island closed?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I changed the gate's operating spell so that only a few people, including you, %s, can use it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. See you both later.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I hope you reach the island without any trouble.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Until next time, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Maybe Hayden will know something.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Hello, %s.
(Hayden greets you with a bright smile and a nod, remembering to wave Marie's hand as well.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden, how is the island?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: With that person... I mean, Circe gone, everything has returned to normal.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Scylla and Glaucos are both getting plenty of rest, so they seem all right. Although Circe's curse still hasn't been broken...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: They don't seem overly unhappy with their current condition. Still, I hope we find a way to restore their original forms soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I learn how, I'll tell you too.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: You really are kind...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Thank you for coming to Aie Island. Glaucos and every other being on the island welcome you.
(At Hayden's words, dolls that were nowhere to be seen suddenly appear behind him.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Now, a welcoming round of applause!
(Following Hayden's instructions, the dolls applaud the adventurer. Then they disappear somewhere as though nothing happened.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, those dolls...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: ...They're dolls.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? What do you mean? Surely the dolls here were people under a curse...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: When the people were freed from the curse, lots of usable stuffing fell all over the place. I collected it and made dolls.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm curious. Why did you make them?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Because of Circe's curse, many spirits and fairies left or reached the ends of their lives. I managed to revive a few... But they couldn't maintain their original forms...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: So I had them move into dolls. Glaucos blessed them too, allowing them to move stably.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: The goddess Iris also promised to help them return to their original forms someday, though she can't do it right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... I see.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: You're looking for something, aren't you? An hourglass, and what else?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you know about the hourglasses too, Hayden.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Another spirit told me you're looking for the hourglasses that fell from Pneuma.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Would you tell me what else you're looking for?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm looking for letters that were carried here by the wind.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Letters...? Oh!
(As Hayden's face lights up in recognition, Marie raises both arms in his embrace and shows you something.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: This, right? There's magic left in it, so it seems important...
(Hayden hands %s a letter that appears to belong to Notos.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes, I think that's it. Are there any more?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: This is the only one I have, but it seems all the letters carried by the wind came to Aie Island. Oh, you'll need to hurry.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: They contain a trace of magic, so the dolls and devils may have reacted to them. They might have torn them up or used them for something else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'd better find them quickly.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Once you've found the letters and returned them to their owner, go to the place that comes to mind. The hidden hourglass will awaken there.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: When you find it, bring it to me. I'll send it back to Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Hayden. I'll start looking right away.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Yes, and... Oh, you've already gone.
(Watching the adventurer leave, Hayden raises Marie's arm and makes her scratch her head.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: There were so many letters that I wanted to help. Will it be all right, Marie? Hm? You think the adventurer will be fine?

steps.name: Colors of Emotion (11)
steps.objective: Defeat [Zephyros] in 「Magic Training Hall」 to obtain the <Yellow Hourglass>. Then find [Hayden] on 「Aie Island」 and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: %s, you're back?
(Notos spots %s approaching in the distance and hurries over.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: My goodness, I never thought you'd find them all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There were more letters than I expected. Fifty of them... I felt like I'd suddenly become a postal worker.
(Tears well in Notos's eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. That was a thoughtless joke. I didn't mean anything bad by it.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Haha, no. It's all right. It's my fault for failing to talk properly with my brother.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: He dislikes me so much he won't even accept my letters.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, here are the letters.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: You've gone to such trouble. How can I ever repay this kindness?
(Notos smiles brightly as he receives his lost letters from %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I didn't do it expecting anything in return.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Did you finish your own business?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not yet. I thought there might be a clue if I went to the island...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If the hourglass had been on Aie Island, Hayden surely would have told me...)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: If you have a moment, would you listen to my story?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, of course.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I kept writing to Zephyros because I wanted to reconcile. Both over our different approaches to magic and as family...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ten years ago, our father died in an accident. When it was just the two of us, things were far from easy.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I sometimes wished for the kind of luck a boy in a heroic tale has: to rise quickly and become the center of the world.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Perhaps a god heard that boy's wish. With help from many people, we were fortunate enough to attend a small boarding school in the capital.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: My brother was popular and had romantic entanglements with girls. I suddenly remember one girl telling me she'd break my glasses if I wore them. Her name was Chloris... Oh, she...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... Zephyros and Chloris are both working at the academy now.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I was surprised to hear that. Hahaha. I don't know what their relationship is like now, but...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: After graduating, we naturally came to work for the Magic Bureau. Then, by chance, we discovered something.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: That the Magic Bureau had been involved in what happened ten years ago...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What exactly was that incident?
(Notos looks flustered at %s's question.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Oh... I thought you knew about it. Since you work on matters connected to His Majesty...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know the details... I just have the impression that something bad happened.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I see. Perhaps you'll learn when the time comes. For now, I must remain silent. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Haha. Apart from that incident, I can tell you more. At the time, my brother and I disagreed and had a terrible argument...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I left the Magic Bureau and went to the Sage's Tower...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Someday, I want to face my brother and talk properly. I should not have spoken so carelessly...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're a good older brother. I'm sure that day will come.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Thank you, %s. As brothers, friends, and beings who share the same soul, we should be a little more honest with each other.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: We are twins, after all.
(Looking relieved, Notos stretches.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Is it that late already? I need to get back to work. What are your plans, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I... I just thought of somewhere I need to go!

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Where are you going?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a secret. Ahaha, for a moment I sounded like someone else...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Then allow me to see you off. You're heading toward the Guild Union, aren't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Huh? Sigh... Yes, that's right. No hiding it now.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Haha. I hope your journey is uneventful. Until next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye, Notos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I can feel his love for his brother. The place that comes to mind is the Magic Academy... Should I start by searching the training hall?)
(With the cooperation of the Magic Academy's student council, you search here and there and spot something glowing yellow to one side.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Here it is. I'm glad I found it sooner than expected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just looking at it makes me happy... Even simply wishing for someone else's happiness... Oh, right. The yellow hourglass must contain the emotion of happiness...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I want to be happy...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, is that the hourglass's influence? Phew, what am I saying? I'd better hurry back to Hayden.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Welcome, adventurer.
(Once again, Hayden welcomes you by waving the doll Marie's hand.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I felt happiness approaching from the moment you stepped onto the island.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I never knew this hourglass, holding some of the emotions of so many living beings, would be so powerful. If even a spirit like me can feel it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I found it quickly thanks to you, Hayden.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Not at all.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I'm the one who should thank you. Spirits work for living beings, but we don't easily experience emotions like these.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I'm truly fortunate to feel this emotion. I'm glad I met you.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: You're fortunate too, aren't you, Marie?
(Hayden makes the doll Marie nod, as though she agrees.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Hayden.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Then would you give me the hourglass?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here. It takes a spirit's power to make this hourglass disappear, right? Will you chant a special spell or perform some special action too?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I haven't prepared anything like that... I've heard that some spirits chant spells. But I don't.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Now, Marie. Ready?
(Hayden sets Marie on a nearby rock. She nods as though she understands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You saw Marie move just now, didn't you? I wasn't imagining it, right?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: W-Who knows? Hehe...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He's trying to smooth it over with a smile and a look of complete innocence... Let's watch for now.)
(Marie takes the yellow hourglass from Hayden and begins spinning. Soon, yellow light streams from the hourglass, scattering across the island.)
(After spinning for a while, Marie sinks to the ground, apparently dizzy.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Well done, Marie. Take a little rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It certainly seems finished.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: The sand of emotion has returned where it belongs.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. The container that held the sand hasn't disappeared. It can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I suppose we should send this back where it came from too?
(With a small smile, Hayden tosses the empty hourglass skyward. It drifts into a vortex of magic and quickly vanishes.)
Hoooooot!
(Somewhere, an owl cries out in pain, as though something has struck it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was that my imagination? I thought I heard an owl being hit by something...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: The empty hourglass has gone to Pneuma, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: There are two left now, correct? Emotions of passion and love, and the wish for hope and peace...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think so.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I don't know where or how you'll encounter the remaining two hourglasses...

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: But they don't seem to have appeared yet. If they had appeared somewhere, the spirits would sense them.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Come here, Marie.
(Hayden picks up the collapsed Marie and holds her again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Once again, thank you, Hayden. I'll see you later.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: You're welcome, adventurer. If you need help again, please ask. Spirits exist to work for living beings.
(Hayden gathers the collapsed Marie back into his arms. The doll who moved only moments ago lies as still as an ordinary doll.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...The world really is full of things I don't understand. That doll included... I suppose I'll find the other two hourglasses someday...
(For an instant, the adventurer catches Marie twitching.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think she moved again just now... Let's pretend I didn't see.)
